Thank you very much!!

Carina

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Deployed project says "NOT FOUND"
parts:
There should not be a need to change the working directory for a shinyapps.io app. And path references must be relative, not absolute.

For Shiny specific questions, I would suggest heading to the shiny-discuss group and asking there.
